insight: Launched as RealityEngines.AI by ex-AWS AI exec Bindu Reddy, then rebranded to Abacus.AI before adding consumer ChatLLM.
name: Abacus.AI
tagline: Multi-model AI super-assistant with an agent layer for tasks and apps.
description: An AI platform whose consumer product, ChatLLM, puts many frontier models — GPT, Claude, Gemini, and others — behind one subscription, alongside image generation and a code/app builder. Its DeepAgent layer runs multi-step agentic tasks like dashboards, automations, and app builds. The company also sells an end-to-end enterprise generative-AI and ML platform.

modelSupport.notes: One subscription routes across many frontier models plus image generation.

edge: Bundles many frontier models, image generation, and an agentic DeepAgent task layer under one low monthly price instead of separate subscriptions.
